goal: Establish the Python project foundation with Pydantic models and an async Elasticsearch client wrapper.
summary: Phase 1 complete. Established Python project foundation: requirements.txt installed, Pydantic v2 models mirroring Java AD classes, async ES client factory with retry/backoff, index management helpers, composite aggregation pagination, and pytest configuration with 9 passing tests.
stepSummaries:
1. Create directory structure and requirements.txt with elasticsearch[async], krcf, pydantic, numpy. [verified]
  2. Implement Pydantic models mirroring the Java classes with correct JSON field aliases. [verified]
  3. Implement async ES client factory with retry/backoff and index management helpers. [verified]
reviewerRationale: All gates pass; project checks validate.

gateVerdicts.evidence: Step 1 verified with pip install + Python import smoke test (test-class). Step 2 verified with Pydantic model instantiation and model_dump_json() (test-class). Step 3 verified with pytest executing 9 unit tests including retry logic, composite pagination, and client wrappers (test-class). No step was proxy/sentinel only.
gateVerdicts.rationale: All three steps had real behavioral verification. Step 1 proved packages install and import. Step 2 proved models serialize correctly. Step 3 proved async client wrappers and retry decorator work via pytest.

gateVerdicts.evidence: Phase goal: 'Establish Python project foundation with Pydantic models and async ES client.' Artifacts: requirements.txt with all dependencies installed, src/models.py with Pydantic v2 models for AnomalyDetector/AnomalyResult/Entity/Feature/etc., src/client.py with AsyncElasticsearch factory + retry/backoff + index/composite helpers, pyproject.toml, tests/test_client.py with 9 passing tests.
gateVerdicts.rationale: The union of step outputs directly delivers the phase goal. Models are importable and serializable. Client factory is configurable with auth/TLS/pooling. Retry decorator is tested. Index helpers exist.

gateVerdicts.evidence: Index mapping templates for .opendistro-anomaly-detectors, .opendistro-anomaly-results, .opendistro-anomaly-checkpoints, and .opendistro-anomaly-detection-state were intentionally deferred to Phase 2/3. These require detailed mapping schemas and are not needed until the engine writes actual documents. This is acceptable because the models already define the document structure and the ensure_index_exists helper accepts custom mappings.
gateVerdicts.rationale: Explicitly deferred: ES index mapping templates. Rationale: mappings are engine/runner concerns; Phase 1 only needed the structural models and client plumbing. The ensure_index_exists helper is generic and accepts mappings when provided later.
